outbound_links.py:165-166: "Local import keeps the differ free of module-scope heavy imports (standalone-loaded in tests)." — same file states it IS standalone-loaded

tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py:74-76 extends `rebar_reconciler.__path__` to the engine dir so `from rebar_reconciler.<name> import ...` resolves — this (not the absence of standalone loading) is what makes the import safe
advisory.finding: The new module-level comment claims outbound_links is 'only ever loaded as the rebar_reconciler.outbound_links package submodule (never spec-loaded standalone)', but the same file's `_diff_link_removals` docstring (and inbound_differ's by-path `_load_link_direction`) state the differ IS standalone-loaded in tests; the module-scope package import only happens to be safe because package resolution is pre-established by conftest sys.path/__path__ setup, not because standalone loading never occurs. The comment's rationale is inaccurate and could mislead a future edit into adding a genuinely heavy top-level import.
